issues.location: Section: The Paradox of Large Context Windows
issues.description: The term 'Lost in the Namespace' is used alongside 'Lost in the Middle'. While descriptive, it is not a standard industry term and may confuse readers looking for established research.
issues.fix: Stick to the established term 'Lost in the Middle' or clarify that 'Lost in the Namespace' is a colloquial way to describe the phenomenon.

strengths: Perfect adherence to the multi-section specification and required ordering.
The End-to-End example provides a complete, high-fidelity walkthrough of the 'Zoom-In' method with intermediate AI responses.
Excellent use of MDX features including titled code blocks and correctly placed admonitions.
Strong pedagogical structure, moving from theoretical problems (Paradox) to concrete implementation patterns (Pruning, Mapping, Compression).
Code examples are highly relevant, runnable, and demonstrate the 'before/after' or 'full/skeletal' comparison requested in the spec.
